value: A training job gets CPU only for something new to learn (a stronger teacher, inputs the net cannot see today, new content), judged on the gauntlet protocol; it stops at the plateau: after each round play the one-turn cell gauntlet (500 sequences) --against the net from two rounds back with --d1 4 (three back with --d1 6 for cheap bursts); a pass trains another round, a fail stops.

sources.anchor: Training: when it runs and when it stops (owner, 2026-11-02)
